7.7 of 15 accounts' worth left

#15 and #4 reset. 1 account has no recent reading,
so it isn't counted.

  A day = accounts' worth of weekly limit used a
  day. More accounts = how many more than are
  counted now it would take to keep up with that
  pace for good (pace x 7 days, less the accounts
  counted).
  Assumes cswap auto keeps its best strategy: use
  stays on one account until its week is used up,
  then moves to the one with the most room.
